project.name: C4D_MMD_Tool
project.description: A Cinema 4D C++ plugin for importing MikuMikuDance PMX models and VMD animation data. / 一个用于将 MikuMikuDance PMX 模型和 VMD 动画数据导入 Cinema 4D 的 C++ 插件。 Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results. / 注意：该项目包含超过 100 个源文件；若希望更快完成分析，可考虑将范围限定到某个子目录。

nodes.name: CMTSceneManager.h
nodes.summary: Declares the scene-level PMX, VMD, and VPD orchestration API together with structured result logs for import and export operations. / 声明场景级 PMX、VMD 与 VPD 编排 API，并定义导入导出操作的结构化结果日志。

nodes.name: CMTSceneManager
nodes.summary: Constructs the per-document scene manager used by MMD import and export workflows. / 构造供 MMD 导入导出流程使用的按文档场景管理器。

nodes.name: ~CMTSceneManager
nodes.summary: Releases the per-document scene manager and its tracked runtime state. / 释放按文档存在的场景管理器及其跟踪的运行时状态。

nodes.name: IOLog
nodes.summary: Base diagnostic state providing shared memory and file I/O error dialogs with operation timing. / 基础诊断状态，提供共享的内存与文件读写错误对话框及操作计时。

nodes.name: LoadVmdCameraLog
nodes.summary: Tracks imported VMD camera frame counts and reports camera-specific success or validation failures. / 跟踪导入的 VMD 相机帧数，并报告相机相关成功或校验失败。

nodes.name: SaveVmdCameraLog
nodes.summary: Reports VMD camera export completion and elapsed time. / 报告 VMD 相机导出完成状态与耗时。

nodes.name: ConversionVmdCameraLog
nodes.summary: Carries timing state for camera conversion reporting. / 保存相机转换报告所需的计时状态。

nodes.name: LoadVmdMotionLog
nodes.summary: Accumulates imported motion counts and unmatched bone or morph names for detailed VMD reports. / 累积导入动作数量及未匹配骨骼或变形名称，用于详细 VMD 报告。

nodes.name: SaveVmdMotionLog
nodes.summary: Tracks exported VMD bone, morph, and frame counts and exposes validation error reports. / 跟踪导出的 VMD 骨骼、变形与帧数量，并提供校验错误报告。

nodes.name: LoadVpdPoseLog
nodes.summary: Tracks matched and unmatched VPD pose bones and morphs for import diagnostics. / 跟踪 VPD 姿势导入中匹配与未匹配的骨骼和变形。

nodes.name: SaveVpdPoseLog
nodes.summary: Tracks exported VPD bone and morph counts and reports selection or model errors. / 跟踪导出的 VPD 骨骼与变形数量，并报告选择或模型错误。

nodes.name: LoadModelLog
nodes.summary: Captures imported PMX metadata and enabled element counts for the completion report. / 捕获导入的 PMX 元数据与已启用元素数量，用于完成报告。

nodes.name: SavePmxModelLog
nodes.summary: Captures exported PMX metadata and element counts for the completion report. / 捕获导出的 PMX 元数据与元素数量，用于完成报告。

nodes.name: CMTSceneManager
nodes.summary: Per-document singleton that coordinates MMD model managers and camera objects across import and export workflows. / 按文档存在的单例，负责在导入导出流程中协调 MMD 模型管理器与相机对象。

nodes.name: cmt_tools_setting.h
nodes.summary: Defines document-bound option structures for every camera, motion, pose, and model conversion workflow. / 定义绑定到文档的选项结构，覆盖所有相机、动作、姿势与模型转换流程。

nodes.name: cmt_marco.h
nodes.summary: Collects cross-SDK compatibility macros, constants, type helpers, parameter accessors, and Cinema 4D utility functions. / 汇集跨 SDK 兼容宏、常量、类型辅助、参数访问器与 Cinema 4D 工具函数。
nodes.languageNotes: Centralizes Cinema 4D SDK-version conditionals so the maintained source can compile across multiple SDK trees. / 集中封装 Cinema 4D SDK 版本条件，使同一套维护源码可在多个 SDK 树中编译。

nodes.name: cmt_tools_config_manager.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements configuration loading, default initialization, dialog synchronization, and JSON persistence for tool settings. / 实现工具设置的配置加载、默认值初始化、对话框同步与 JSON 持久化。

nodes.name: InitDialog
nodes.summary: Copies typed configuration values into matching Cinema 4D dialog controls. / 将类型化配置值复制到对应的 Cinema 4D 对话框控件。

nodes.name: InitConfig
nodes.summary: Seeds a configuration entry from its declared default while preserving any compatible persisted value. / 从声明的默认值初始化配置项，同时保留类型兼容的持久化值。

nodes.name: InitConfigManager
nodes.summary: Loads the JSON configuration, initializes the full setting table, and writes defaults when no file exists. / 加载 JSON 配置、初始化完整设置表，并在文件不存在时写入默认值。

nodes.name: SaveConfig
nodes.summary: Serializes the current configuration table to the configured JSON file. / 将当前配置表序列化到指定 JSON 文件。

nodes.name: cmt_tools_config_manager.h
nodes.summary: Defines the singleton configuration manager and its typed configuration table used by plugin dialogs and startup code. / 定义单例配置管理器及其类型化配置表，供插件对话框和启动代码使用。
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a C++ variant-backed table with templated getters and setters to keep heterogeneous settings type-safe. / 使用基于 C++ variant 的表和模板化读写接口，使异构设置保持类型安全。

nodes.name: CMTToolConfigManager
nodes.summary: Constructs the singleton configuration manager and its default setting table. / 构造单例配置管理器及其默认设置表。

nodes.name: operator =
nodes.summary: Disables or controls assignment for the singleton configuration manager. / 禁用或控制单例配置管理器的赋值。

nodes.name: CMTToolConfigManager
nodes.summary: Singleton service that owns typed tool settings, default declarations, dialog binding, and JSON persistence. / 单例服务，负责类型化工具设置、默认值声明、对话框绑定与 JSON 持久化。

nodes.name: json_util.hpp
nodes.summary: Implements a compact JSON parser, serializer, and file I/O layer for the plugin configuration variant model. / 为插件配置的变体数据模型实现轻量 JSON 解析、序列化与文件读写层。
nodes.languageNotes: A header-only recursive-descent parser serializes the project-specific variant model without an external JSON dependency. / 采用仅头文件的递归下降解析器，在不依赖外部 JSON 库的情况下序列化项目专用变体模型。

nodes.name: cmt_tools_manager.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the high-level commands that import and export VMD cameras, motions, VPD poses, and PMX models through libMMD and the scene manager. / 实现通过 libMMD 与场景管理器导入导出 VMD 相机、动作、VPD 姿势和 PMX 模型的高层命令。

nodes.name: ImportVMDCamera
nodes.summary: Reads and imports VMDCamera data into the active Cinema 4D document through the scene manager. / 读取 VMDCamera 数据，并通过场景管理器导入当前 Cinema 4D 文档。

nodes.name: ConversionCamera
nodes.summary: Converts the selected Cinema 4D camera representation through the scene manager. / 通过场景管理器转换选定的 Cinema 4D 相机表示。

nodes.name: ExportVMDCamera
nodes.summary: Collects VMDCamera data from the active scene and writes it through the matching MMD serializer. / 从当前场景收集 VMDCamera 数据，并通过对应的 MMD 序列化器写出。

nodes.name: ImportVMDMotion
nodes.summary: Reads and imports VMDMotion data into the active Cinema 4D document through the scene manager. / 读取 VMDMotion 数据，并通过场景管理器导入当前 Cinema 4D 文档。

nodes.name: ImportVPDPose
nodes.summary: Reads and imports VPDPose data into the active Cinema 4D document through the scene manager. / 读取 VPDPose 数据，并通过场景管理器导入当前 Cinema 4D 文档。

nodes.name: ExportVPDPose
nodes.summary: Collects VPDPose data from the active scene and writes it through the matching MMD serializer. / 从当前场景收集 VPDPose 数据，并通过对应的 MMD 序列化器写出。

nodes.name: ExportVMDMotion
nodes.summary: Collects VMDMotion data from the active scene and writes it through the matching MMD serializer. / 从当前场景收集 VMDMotion 数据，并通过对应的 MMD 序列化器写出。

nodes.name: ImportPMXModel
nodes.summary: Reads and imports PMXModel data into the active Cinema 4D document through the scene manager. / 读取 PMXModel 数据，并通过场景管理器导入当前 Cinema 4D 文档。

nodes.name: ExportPMXModel
nodes.summary: Collects PMXModel data from the active scene and writes it through the matching MMD serializer. / 从当前场景收集 PMXModel 数据，并通过对应的 MMD 序列化器写出。

nodes.name: cmt_tools_manager.h
nodes.summary: Declares the public tool-command surface for camera, motion, pose, and model import and export. / 声明相机、动作、姿势与模型导入导出的公共工具命令接口。

nodes.name: cmt_name_conversion_dialog.h
nodes.summary: Declares the reusable name-mapping engine and Cinema 4D dialog used to edit and apply local-to-universal name conversions. / 声明可复用的名称映射引擎及 Cinema 4D 对话框，用于编辑并应用本地名到通用名的转换。

nodes.name: filename_util.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides binary file reading, suffix validation, and Cinema 4D import/export file-selection helpers. / 提供二进制文件读取、后缀校验及 Cinema 4D 导入导出文件选择辅助。

nodes.name: string_util.hpp
nodes.summary: Converts Cinema 4D strings to UTF-8 standard strings for library and filesystem boundaries. / 将 Cinema 4D 字符串转换为 UTF-8 标准字符串，用于库与文件系统边界。

nodes.name: main.cpp
nodes.summary: Provides the Cinema 4D plugin lifecycle entry points, registering components and initializing or saving shared configuration. / 提供 Cinema 4D 插件生命周期入口，负责注册组件并初始化或保存共享配置。

nodes.name: PluginStart
nodes.summary: Registers all plugin entities and initializes name-conversion and configuration services at startup. / 在启动时注册全部插件实体，并初始化名称转换与配置服务。

nodes.name: PluginEnd
nodes.summary: Persists shared tool configuration during plugin shutdown. / 在插件关闭时持久化共享工具配置。

nodes.name: PluginMessage
nodes.summary: Handles Cinema 4D system messages required for resource initialization and plugin integration. / 处理资源初始化与插件集成所需的 Cinema 4D 系统消息。

nodes.name: register_entity.h
nodes.summary: Declares the central registration routine that exposes all MMD Tool plugins to Cinema 4D. / 声明中央注册例程，将所有 MMD Tool 插件注册到 Cinema 4D。

nodes.name: MakeObjectColorProperties
nodes.summary: Builds a color-property bundle used to apply display color, color mode, and X-ray state together. / 构建颜色属性组合，用于统一应用显示颜色、颜色模式与 X-ray 状态。

nodes.name: MakeDescIDGeData
nodes.summary: Wraps a description ID as GeData for Cinema 4D parameter APIs. / 将描述 ID 封装为 GeData，供 Cinema 4D 参数 API 使用。

nodes.name: GetDocumentTime
nodes.summary: Returns the active document time with a zero-time fallback for null documents. / 返回活动文档时间，并在文档为空时回退到零时间。

nodes.name: cmt_name_conversion_dialog.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the name-conversion dialog, mapping-file discovery, editable mappings, conversion lookup, and automatic scene-name updates. / 实现名称转换对话框、映射文件发现、可编辑映射、转换查询与场景名称自动更新。

nodes.name: UpdateNameConversionDialog
nodes.summary: Discovers mapping files, initializes the dialog state, and selects the requested conversion table. / 发现映射文件、初始化对话框状态，并选择请求的转换表。

nodes.name: CreateLayout
nodes.summary: Constructs the scrollable mapping editor, controls, and conversion actions in the Cinema 4D dialog. / 在 Cinema 4D 对话框中构建可滚动映射编辑器、控件与转换操作。

nodes.name: InitValues
nodes.summary: Populates initial control values after the dialog layout has been created. / 在对话框布局创建后填充控件初始值。

nodes.name: LoadNameMappingConfig
nodes.summary: Loads the selected mapping configuration and refreshes editable name pairs. / 加载选定的映射配置并刷新可编辑名称对。

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: Dispatches dialog commands for editing mappings, selecting presets, converting names, and saving changes. / 分派对话框命令，处理映射编辑、预设选择、名称转换与更改保存。

nodes.name: Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the shared name-conversion service from available mapping data. / 使用可用映射数据初始化共享名称转换服务。

nodes.name: ~NameConversion
nodes.summary: Implements the ~NameConversion operation within this file's primary responsibility. / 在该文件的主要职责范围内实现 ~NameConversion 操作。

nodes.name: LoadConfig
nodes.summary: Reads a name-mapping file and rebuilds the local and universal lookup tables. / 读取名称映射文件，并重建本地名与通用名查询表。

nodes.name: InitConver
nodes.summary: Traverses a scene hierarchy and prepares object names for conversion. / 遍历场景层级并准备待转换的对象名称。

nodes.name: Conver
nodes.summary: Looks up a source name in the selected conversion direction and returns the mapped result. / 按选定转换方向查找源名称并返回映射结果。

nodes.name: CheckUpdate
nodes.summary: Checks whether automatic name conversion should run for the current scene state. / 检查当前场景状态是否应执行自动名称转换。

nodes.name: AutoUpdate
nodes.summary: Applies configured automatic name conversion when the tracked scene state changes. / 在被跟踪的场景状态变化时应用已配置的自动名称转换。

nodes.name: NameConversion
nodes.summary: Constructs the name-conversion mapping engine from the selected data source. / 从选定数据源构造名称转换映射引擎。

nodes.name: ~UpdateNameConversionDialog
nodes.summary: Closes the name-conversion dialog and releases dialog-owned state. / 关闭名称转换对话框并释放对话框持有的状态。

nodes.name: UpdateNameConversionDialog
nodes.summary: Cinema 4D dialog for selecting, editing, saving, and applying name-conversion mappings. / 用于选择、编辑、保存并应用名称转换映射的 Cinema 4D 对话框。

nodes.name: NameConversion
nodes.summary: Owns bidirectional local and universal name maps and applies them to scene object hierarchies. / 维护本地名与通用名的双向映射，并将其应用到场景对象层级。

nodes.name: ReadFileData
nodes.summary: Reads an entire binary file into a byte buffer with explicit failure reporting. / 将完整二进制文件读入字节缓冲区，并显式报告失败。

nodes.name: CheckSuffix
nodes.summary: Checks a filename against an expected extension without changing the path. / 检查文件名是否匹配预期扩展名且不修改路径。

nodes.name: SelectSuffixImportFile
nodes.summary: Opens a Cinema 4D import selector constrained to the requested suffix. / 打开受指定后缀约束的 Cinema 4D 导入文件选择器。

nodes.name: SelectSuffixExportFile
nodes.summary: Opens a Cinema 4D export selector constrained to the requested suffix. / 打开受指定后缀约束的 Cinema 4D 导出文件选择器。

nodes.name: SkipWhitespace
nodes.summary: Advances the parser cursor past JSON whitespace. / 将解析游标推进到 JSON 空白之后。

nodes.name: Peek
nodes.summary: Returns the next non-whitespace JSON character without consuming a value. / 返回下一个非空白 JSON 字符，但不消费值。

nodes.name: Expect
nodes.summary: Consumes a required JSON token and raises a parse error when it is absent. / 消费必需的 JSON 标记，并在缺失时抛出解析错误。

nodes.name: ParseString
nodes.summary: Parses a quoted JSON string including supported escape sequences. / 解析带引号的 JSON 字符串及其支持的转义序列。

nodes.name: ParseValue
nodes.summary: Dispatches recursive parsing for JSON strings, numbers, booleans, nulls, and objects. / 递归分派 JSON 字符串、数字、布尔值、null 与对象的解析。

nodes.name: ParseObject
nodes.summary: Parses a JSON object into the configuration object representation. / 将 JSON 对象解析为配置对象表示。

nodes.name: EscapeString
nodes.summary: Escapes control characters and quotes for valid JSON string output. / 转义控制字符与引号以生成合法 JSON 字符串。

nodes.name: SerializeValue
nodes.summary: Serializes one variant-held configuration value to JSON. / 将一个由 variant 保存的配置值序列化为 JSON。

nodes.name: Parse
nodes.summary: Parses a complete JSON string and rejects trailing content. / 解析完整 JSON 字符串并拒绝尾随内容。

nodes.name: Serialize
nodes.summary: Serializes a complete configuration object to JSON text. / 将完整配置对象序列化为 JSON 文本。

nodes.name: ReadJsonFile
nodes.summary: Reads and parses a JSON configuration file with safe fallback behavior. / 读取并解析 JSON 配置文件，并提供安全回退行为。

nodes.name: WriteJsonFile
nodes.summary: Serializes and writes a configuration object to disk. / 将配置对象序列化并写入磁盘。

nodes.name: GetStdString
nodes.summary: Encodes a Cinema 4D String as a UTF-8 std::string. / 将 Cinema 4D String 编码为 UTF-8 std::string。

nodes.languageNotes: C++ integrates Cinema 4D SDK lifecycle hooks with explicit PMX/VMD conversion and runtime state management. / C++ 将 Cinema 4D SDK 生命周期钩子与显式 PMX/VMD 转换及运行时状态管理结合。

nodes.name: BoolResetGuard

nodes.name: NormalizeBoneMode
nodes.summary: NormalizeBoneMode normalizes bone mode for bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / NormalizeBoneMode 为骨骼层级与运行时协调规范化 bone mode。

nodes.name: GetBoneTagName
nodes.summary: GetBoneTagName retrieves bone tag name for bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / GetBoneTagName 为骨骼层级与运行时协调获取 bone tag name。

nodes.name: GetDocumentTimeOrInvalid
nodes.summary: GetDocumentTimeOrInvalid retrieves document time or invalid for bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / GetDocumentTimeOrInvalid 为骨骼层级与运行时协调获取 document time or invalid。

nodes.name: ReadBoneIndexParameter
nodes.summary: ReadBoneIndexParameter reads bone index parameter for bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / ReadBoneIndexParameter 为骨骼层级与运行时协调读取 bone index parameter。

nodes.name: ResolveBoneLinkIndex
nodes.summary: ResolveBoneLinkIndex resolves bone link index for bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / ResolveBoneLinkIndex 为骨骼层级与运行时协调解析 bone link index。

nodes.name: ReadIndexFromStringParameter
nodes.summary: ReadIndexFromStringParameter reads index from string parameter for bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / ReadIndexFromStringParameter 为骨骼层级与运行时协调读取 index from string parameter。

nodes.summary: ToEigenVector3f implements a focused operation in bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / ToEigenVector3f 实现骨骼层级与运行时协调中的专用操作。

nodes.name: InitDefaultPmxBone
nodes.summary: InitDefaultPmxBone initializes default pmx bone for bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / InitDefaultPmxBone 为骨骼层级与运行时协调初始化 default pmx bone。

nodes.name: ClearBoneFlag
nodes.summary: ClearBoneFlag clears bone flag for bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / ClearBoneFlag 为骨骼层级与运行时协调清除 bone flag。

nodes.name: BuildBoneFlags
nodes.summary: BuildBoneFlags builds bone flags for bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / BuildBoneFlags 为骨骼层级与运行时协调构建 bone flags。

nodes.name: DescItemHasParent
nodes.summary: DescItemHasParent implements a focused operation in bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / DescItemHasParent 实现骨骼层级与运行时协调中的专用操作。

nodes.name: CollectPmxIkLinks
nodes.summary: CollectPmxIkLinks collects pmx ik links for bone hierarchy and runtime coordination. / CollectPmxIkLinks 为骨骼层级与运行时协调收集 pmx ik links。

nodes.name: ResolveIkTargetBoneIndex

tour.title: Project Overview / 项目概览
tour.description: Start with README.md to understand the plugin's user-facing purpose, installation path, and PMX/VMD feature set. This context establishes what the runtime must accomplish before the tour enters Cinema 4D lifecycle code. / 从 README.md 开始，了解插件面向用户的用途、安装路径以及 PMX/VMD 功能范围。这些背景先明确运行时必须完成的目标，再进入 Cinema 4D 生命周期代码。

tour.title: Plugin Startup / 插件启动
tour.description: main.cpp is the code entry point: it participates in the Cinema 4D plugin lifecycle, initializes shared configuration, and reaches the registration API identified by the BFS traversal. register_entity.cpp then exposes the scene manager, loaders, object/tag plugins, and command UI, while the configuration contract keeps startup and dialogs consistent. / main.cpp 是代码入口：它参与 Cinema 4D 插件生命周期、初始化共享配置，并沿 BFS 路径连接到注册 API。随后 register_entity.cpp 注册场景管理器、加载器、对象与标签插件以及命令 UI，而配置协议保证启动流程与对话框行为一致。
tour.languageLesson: Cinema 4D plugins expose lifecycle callbacks and register each plugin type through stable numeric identities; keeping registration centralized makes startup ordering auditable. / Cinema 4D 插件通过生命周期回调与稳定数值 ID 注册各类插件；集中注册可以让启动顺序更容易审计。

tour.title: Import Orchestration / 导入编排
tour.description: Building on startup, the tool dialog and VMD loader collect user intent and hand commands to the high-level tools manager. CMTSceneManager forms the scene boundary that coordinates PMX models, VMD motion/cameras, VPD poses, and structured operation reports instead of scattering file workflows across plugins. / 在启动层之上，工具对话框与 VMD 加载器收集用户意图，并把命令交给高层工具管理器。CMTSceneManager 构成场景边界，集中协调 PMX 模型、VMD 动作与相机、VPD 姿势及结构化操作报告，避免文件流程散落在各插件中。

tour.title: Model and Morph Runtime / 模型与变形运行时
tour.description: mmd_model_manager.cpp has the graph's highest fan-out, while its header has the highest fan-in, marking this pair as the central runtime hub. The mesh manager translates geometry and BDEF/SDEF weights, and the morph layer persists and evaluates group, flip, mesh, UV, bone, material, and impulse morph families around that hub. / mmd_model_manager.cpp 在图中具有最高扇出，其头文件具有最高扇入，因此这对文件是核心运行时枢纽。网格管理器转换几何与 BDEF/SDEF 权重，变形层则围绕该枢纽持久化并求值组、翻转、网格、UV、骨骼、材质与冲量等变形类型。

tour.title: Bone Animation and IK / 骨骼动画与 IK
tour.description: The bone tag is the second broadest file by fan-out, implementing bind-state persistence, append transforms, interpolation, layered IK, and the handoff to physics. The bone manager orders the hierarchy and execution layers, while the control utility maps animator-facing spline controls back into bone-space deltas. / 骨骼标签按扇出排名第二，负责绑定状态持久化、附加变换、插值、分层 IK 以及向物理阶段的交接。骨骼管理器安排层级与执行分层，控制工具则把动画师操作的样条控制器映射回骨骼空间增量。
tour.languageLesson: The runtime treats EDIT and ANIM behavior as explicit state transitions and uses ordered evaluation layers so append transforms, IK, and physics do not overwrite one another unpredictably. / 运行时将 EDIT 与 ANIM 行为视为显式状态切换，并使用有序求值分层，避免附加变换、IK 与物理以不可预测的方式互相覆盖。

tour.title: Physics Runtime / 物理运行时
tour.description: After bone evaluation, rigid-body and joint managers translate PMX definitions into runtime bodies and constraints, including collision settings, index remapping, and edit/runtime transform transitions. Their object and manager split keeps per-element visualization and execution separate from collection-level construction and lifecycle ownership. / 骨骼求值之后，刚体与关节管理器把 PMX 定义转换为运行时刚体和约束，包括碰撞设置、索引重映射以及编辑与运行时变换切换。对象与管理器的拆分让单元素可视化和执行职责，与集合级构建及生命周期所有权保持分离。

tour.title: Materials and Renderers / 材质与渲染器
tour.description: The renderer-agnostic material model converts PMX data, persists shared state, and dispatches through renderer adapters; its high fan-out reflects that coordinating role. Standard, Redshift, and Octane implementations translate the common model into renderer-specific nodes, while the morph shader applies precomputed texture factors without consulting mutable scene state during rendering. / 与渲染器无关的材质模型转换 PMX 数据、持久化共享状态并分发到渲染器适配器；较高扇出体现了它的协调职责。Standard、Redshift 与 Octane 实现把通用模型转换为渲染器专用节点，而变形 Shader 使用预计算贴图系数，避免渲染期间读取可变场景状态。

tour.title: Resources and Localization / 资源与本地化
tour.description: Runtime behavior becomes user-facing through the S24+ configuration defaults, Attribute Manager description, English and Simplified Chinese string tables, and MMD palette data. Reading these together shows how one stable parameter vocabulary drives defaults, layout, localization, and visual compatibility without duplicating C++ logic. / 运行时行为通过 S24+ 配置默认值、属性管理器描述、英文与简体中文字符串表以及 MMD 调色板数据呈现给用户。把这些文件放在一起阅读，可以看到同一套稳定参数词汇如何驱动默认值、布局、本地化与视觉兼容，而无需复制 C++ 逻辑。
tour.languageLesson: Cinema 4D resources separate symbolic parameter IDs, declarative UI descriptions, and locale-specific STRINGTABLE values; IDs must remain stable while labels can evolve independently. / Cinema 4D 资源将符号参数 ID、声明式 UI 描述与特定语言的 STRINGTABLE 文本分离；ID 必须保持稳定，而标签可以独立演进。

tour.title: Build and SDK Bridge / 构建与 SDK 桥接
tour.description: The root CMake workflow and presets coordinate dependencies, tests, packaging, and multi-SDK builds, while shared plugin setup prevents each compatibility tree from becoming a fork. sdk_targets.cmake is a topology hotspot for source discovery and target generation, and the SDK 2026 wrapper demonstrates how a thin project binds the shared source and S24+ resources to one concrete SDK. / 根级 CMake 工作流与预设协调依赖、测试、打包和多 SDK 构建，共享插件设置则避免每个兼容树演变成独立分叉。sdk_targets.cmake 是源码发现与目标生成的拓扑热点，SDK 2026 包装层展示了精简工程如何把共享源码与 S24+ 资源绑定到具体 SDK。
tour.languageLesson: CMake presets name repeatable configure/build profiles, while thin SDK wrappers delegate common behavior to shared functions and variables instead of copying target logic. / CMake 预设为可重复的配置与构建方案命名，精简 SDK 包装层则把通用行为委托给共享函数和变量，而不是复制目标逻辑。

tour.title: CI and Releases / CI 与发布
tour.description: The reusable or manually dispatched build workflow runs 21 Release jobs: eight Windows 2022 x64 builds, eight Intel macOS 26 x86_64 builds, and five Apple Silicon macOS 26 arm64 builds limited to R25 and 2023–2026. Each job checks out Bullet and libMMD, reuses or builds dependencies, configures root CMake presets, and uploads the supported Windows and Intel artifacts. The tag-triggered packaging workflow reuses these builds to assemble the Windows Inno installer and per-SDK macOS archives for GitHub Release. / 可复用或手动触发的构建工作流运行 21 个 Release 作业：8 个 Windows 2022 x64 构建、8 个 Intel macOS 26 x86_64 构建，以及仅覆盖 R25 与 2023–2026 的 5 个 Apple Silicon macOS 26 arm64 构建。每个作业都会检出 Bullet 与 libMMD、复用或构建依赖、配置根级 CMake 预设，并上传受支持的 Windows 与 Intel 产物。由标签触发的打包工作流复用这些构建，组装 Windows Inno 安装包与逐 SDK macOS 压缩包，并发布到 GitHub Release。
tour.languageLesson: GitHub Actions reusable workflows can combine a full compatibility matrix with an architecture-specific subset, while downstream tag jobs consume tested artifacts instead of duplicating compiler logic. / GitHub Actions 可复用工作流可以把完整兼容矩阵与特定架构子集结合起来，下游标签任务则消费已经验证的产物，避免重复编译逻辑。

tour.title: Developer Deep Dives / 开发者深入指南
tour.description: Finish with the development guide and the import, export, runtime, and animation-debug maps, which connect the architectural stops above to concrete ownership boundaries, failure paths, diagnostics, and acceptance checks. These documents are the fastest route from orientation to safe modification because they explain not only where code lives, but how to verify behavior across Cinema 4D modes and SDKs. / 最后阅读开发指南以及导入、导出、运行时与动画调试地图，把前述架构节点连接到具体所有权边界、失败路径、诊断方法与验收检查。这些文档不仅说明代码位置，还解释如何跨 Cinema 4D 模式与 SDK 验证行为，因此是从理解项目走向安全修改的最快路径。
